name: Adinazolam
metabolism: Human metabolism has not yet been verified for this entry. Responsible enzymes, metabolites and elimination routes are not specified. This is a documentation gap, not evidence that the substance is not metabolized; do not infer a pathway from related compounds.
summary: Adinazolam is a triazolobenzodiazepine tranquilizer with anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, sedative, and antidepressant properties. It was developed to enhance alprazolam's antidepressant effects but was never FDA approved; it has been sold as a designer drug.
